summary: A Yes vote authorizes Lodi Unified School District to issue up to $195 million in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities, with citizen oversight and annual audits.

tax.text: A Yes vote continues the Measure K bond tax rate to fund school and classroom repair and construction.
tax.quote: Measure T is designed as a tax rate extension and continuation of Lodi Unified School District's Measure K bond, which expires in 2029 when all bonds of Measure K will be paid and no longer outstanding.

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for repair and construction at Lodi Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: Measure T will be used strictly for school and classroom repair and construction purposes, in accordance with California law.

tax.text: A No vote does not continue the Measure K bond tax rate after the existing bonds expire.
tax.quote: Measure T is designed as a tax rate extension and continuation of Lodi Unified School District's Measure K bond, which expires in 2029 when all bonds of Measure K will be paid and no longer outstanding.

schools.text: A No vote does not provide the Measure T bond funding for those district school projects.
